 versus

 Through: Mr. Amit Ahlawat, App for the
 with Si Prakash Kashyap
 Ms. Tara Narula, Advocate for
 Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of case FIR No. 752/2023 of PS Rajouri Garden for offence under Section 498A/354/509/506/323/34 IPC on the ground that complainant de facto (respondent no.
2) has compromised the disputes with them.
2. Learned APP accepts notice and objects to the quashing of the FIR on the ground that partial quashing is not permissible in law.
Besides, learned APP has also referred to the serious allegations of sexual misconduct mentioned in para 11 of the FIR.
3. Learned counsel for respondent no. 2 accepts notice and seeks adjournment to examine as to whether partial quashing of FIR is permissible.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/08/2025 at 22:52:01 4.
In the meanwhile, as requested by counsel for petitioner, the remaining accused persons also be impleaded by filing amended memo of parties and their supporting affidavits within one week.
This is a digitally signed order.
